Planning Records¶

This section records design proposals, roadmap decisions, and block definitions for the MohidNG-oriented restructuring of VoronoiMeshMaker.

The source material imported from the Codex packages is preserved under docs/source/planning/source-packages. The pages in this section are the working synthesis used to guide implementation.
